(()=>{ const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Design'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return 'clicked Design'; } return 'Design button not found'; })()

(()=>{ const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('Architectural workspace')); if (btn) { btn.click(); return 'clicked Architectural workspace'; } return 'Architectural workspace not found'; })()
(()=>{ const d = document.querySelector('.alteration-panel'); if (d) { d.open = true; d.scrollIntoView({block:'start'}); return 'opened alteration panel'; } return 'alteration panel not found'; })()

(()=>{ const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.alteration-table tbody tr')).map(tr => tr.innerText.replace(/\n/g,' | ')); return JSON.stringify({ rowCount: rows.length, rows: rows.slice(0,8) }); })()

(()=>{ const d = document.querySelector('.alteration-stage-preview'); if (d) { d.open = true; d.scrollIntoView({block:'start'}); return 'opened stage preview'; } return 'stage preview not found'; })()
